pr_title: feat(test-runner) correct testResult onStepEnd and onStepBegin
pr_body:
## How it works:
If you use `testInfo.attach()` inside step attachment will be flagged as `isStepAttachment` and appended to `stepAttachments` field inside `step`.

Reporters can access current step attachments
```ts
onStepEnd(test: TestCase, result: TestResult, step: TestStep) {
  console.log(step.stepAttachments)
}
```


depends on #17082

fixes #17038 
fixes #14364
fixes #11592
pr_comments:
I believe the plan was to make sure testInfo.attachments are up-to-date in the onStepBegin / onStepEnd calls.

@baev ^^
@pavelfeldman i changed PR and i did what we originally planned.

But i think we also need to add attachments in `TestStep`. This will enable Reporters to check `step.attachments` field directly rather than implementing their own logic with `TestResult.attachments` diffs between multiple `onStepEnd` calls.
Closing as per my comments above.

issue_context.title: [Feature] Step-scoped attachments
issue_context.body:
Request from Allure Team (approved by @pavelfeldman , please do not close)

Related issues: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/14364 and https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/11592

PS we have multiple requests for such feature from our paid customers, for us this issue is really high priority as it makes attachments feature unusable in most cases

We don't want dependencies to go from the code of the test runner to the reporter, consider moving required method into the utilities file if you need it here. I'm not sure why you would need it though.
TestResult identity is important, you should always pass the same instance to the user.
